reserveReview.rationale: Historical 2026-08-08 configured-pair observation: all eleven configured pairs were read for underlying(), getPairAccounting(), collateral() and convertToAssets(), yielding $24,371,493 crvUSD-side and $1,713,015 frxUSD-side converted assets, or 93.4% and 6.6% of that configured subtotal. Source-scope correction reviewed 2026-10-20: this configured roster and its unpinned latest-block description do not establish an exhaustive Registry census or a current whole-book denominator. Retain the historical percentages only as classification scaffolding for the exact two source keys, not as a renewed full composition. Current weights and census completeness belong to the admitted live resupply-pairs producer. Both rows remain layered protocol positions with explicit upstream issuer, smart-contract and liquidity risks.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Historical eleven-configured-pair ERC-4626 conversion subtotal reported on 2026-08-08; classification scaffolding only, not a pinned exhaustive Registry or current whole-book observation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Zero refers only to unidentified categories within the two reviewed classification rows, not to proof that the eleven-pair historical configuration covered every registered positive-collateral position. Whole-book omitted exposure and current liquidity are not measured by this static scaffold; no whole-book percentage or withdrawal horizon is inferred. Current admitted live composition must establish its own census and denominator.
